method: Time-indexed search, then spatial filtering and haversine
limitations: Nearby observations can belong to another flight.
A nearby observation is a proxy, not a hazard measurement at the proposed route coordinate.
This does not sample the entire candidate route.
This does not validate airspace, terrain, altitude, airway, ATC, NOTAM applicability, or operational clearance.
The relative hazard indicator is exploratory and is not a calibrated probability of aviation risk.
